text: Program description: The goal of this major is to make students master the basic principles and experimental methods of environmental engineering, to have the basic knowledge needed in the application research, to understand the latest achievements and research progress in the field of environmental science and engineering, to be able to adapt to the ability, to have a wide professional caliber, to have new spirit and practical ability, and to be able to be in the environment. Senior professionals in design, construction, technology development, operation management and teaching work in such areas as protection, pollution prevention and water treatment engineering.Main courses: Principles of chemical engineering, water pollution control engineering, air pollution control engineering, solid waste disposal and disposal, environmental monitoring and evaluation, environmental regulation and management, etc.The industry and field of graduate adaptation: The Bureau of environmental protection, environmental monitoring station, Environmental Science Institute, Environmental Management Institute, environmental science and technology consulting company, colleges and universities with environmental disciplines, secondary specialized schools and scientific research institutes, water plants, sewage treatment plants, various enterprise sewage treatment stations and chemical analysis rooms, water treatment companies, water treatment plants in power plants, electric power design institutes, A variety of environmental protection equipment sales companies, Power Grid Corp, electric power bureau and so on.
